topic: A Mix-Up at the Drive-Thru Window

script.title: MIDNIGHT DRIVE-THRU FIX
script.scene_zh: 速食店車道 · 換飲料
script.story_hook: A late-night order goes wrong at the window.
script.intro_zh: 深夜的一筆訂單，在窗口出了差錯。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to the night shift! Tonight we order from our car.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到夜班時光！今晚我們坐在車裡點餐。
script.outro: Wrong cup, right fix. Polite words go a long way.
script.outro_zh: 杯子弄錯，處理卻很到位。有禮的說話非常有用。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat these drive-thru lines now.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟讀這些車道點餐的句子。
script.char_a_description: A friendly young man in his late twenties with short dark hair, a thin beard, a navy quilted jacket over a gray hoodie, and jeans, holding car keys.
script.char_b_description: A cheerful woman in her thirties with shoulder-length black hair under a red visor cap, a green employee polo shirt, a name tag, and a small headset.
script.thumbnail_expression: surprised, holding up a tiny cup
script.thumbnail_action: paying with a phone at the car window

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good evening! Can I still order food?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈivnɪŋ! kaɪ stɪl ˈɔːrdər fuːd/
dialogue.zh: 晚上好！還點得到餐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the menu is open till two.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈmɛnju ɪz ˈoʊpən tɪl tuː/
dialogue.zh: 可以，菜單供應到凌晨兩點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. I'll take the number four combo.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt. aɪl teɪk ðə ˈnʌmbɚ ˈfɔːr ˈkɑmˌboʊ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我要四號套餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the double burger meal. Good pick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈdʌbəl ˈbɜːɡɚ mil ɡʊd pɪk/
dialogue.zh: 那是雙層漢堡套餐，選得好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly. It's my usual Friday thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli. ɪts maɪ ˈuʒuəl ˈfɹaɪdeɪ θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，這是我的週五固定節目。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Can I do anything else for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ! kaɪ du ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɛls fɔɹ ju/
dialogue.zh: 哈！還要加點別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, um, a large coffee, black.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʌm ə ˈlɑːɹdʒ ˈkɔːfi blæk/
dialogue.zh: 好，呃，一杯大杯黑咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cream or sugar with that?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɹim ɔɹ ˈʃʊɡɚ wɪð ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 要加奶精或糖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Neither. It keeps me awake on night drives.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈniːðɚ. ɪt kiːps mi əˈweɪk ɑn naɪt dɹaɪvz/
dialogue.zh: 都不用。開夜車時它讓我保持清醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Anything sweet to go with it?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑːɹt. ˈɛniˌθɪŋ swiːt tə ɡoʊ wɪð ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。要搭配點甜的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, are the apple pies still warm?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ɑɹ ði ˈæpəl paɪz stɪl wɔːɹm/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，蘋果派還熱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just out of the fryer, piping hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst aʊt əv ðə ˈfɹaɪɚ, ˈpaɪpɪŋ hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 剛從炸鍋取出，燙得很。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, throw one in for the road.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊkeɪ, θɹoʊ wʌn ɪn fɔɹ ðə ɹoʊd/
dialogue.zh: 好，也塞一個讓我路上吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That comes to eleven fifty, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt kʌmz tə ɪˈlɛvən ˈfɪfti pliz/
dialogue.zh: 總共十一塊五，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay with my phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /kaɪ peɪ wɪð maɪ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 可以用手機付款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, just tap right here on the reader.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp dʒʌst tæp ɹaɪt hɪr ɑn ðə ˈɹiːdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，在這裡感應一下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, done. Did it go through okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr dʌn. dɪd ɪt ɡə θɹuː ˌoʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好了。扣款成功了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One second… yep, it shows approved.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈsɛkənd… jɛp ɪt ʃoʊz əˈpɹuːvd/
dialogue.zh: 稍等……成功了，顯示已核准。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Um, oh — hold on a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜːɹfɪkt. ʌm ˈoʊ — ˈhoʊld ɑn ə ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 完美。呃，噢——等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What's up? Did something look wrong?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts ʌp? dɪd ˈsʌmθɪŋ lʊk ɹɔːŋ/
dialogue.zh: 怎麼了？有什麼不對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This drink cup is really tiny.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs drɪŋk kʌp ɪz ˈɹɪli ˈtaɪni/
dialogue.zh: 這杯飲料也太小了吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh my — that's a kids' cup, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊ maɪ — ðæts ə kɪdz kʌp ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 天啊——那是小朋友的杯子，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, I ordered the large fizzy drink.
dialogue.phonetic: /jeɪ, aɪ ˈɔːrdɚd ðə lɑːɹdʒ ˈfɪzi drɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 對呀，我點的是大杯氣飲料。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're totally right. I'm so sorry about that.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈtoʊtli ɹaɪt. aɪm soʊ ˈsɑɹi əˈbaʊt ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 您說得完全沒錯，真抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No big deal, it's a busy night.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bɪɡ diːl, ɪts ə ˈbɪzi naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，今晚生意好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's fix it fast. Are you in a rush?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts fɪks ɪt fæst. ɑɹ ju ɪn ə ɹʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 趕快處理好。您趕時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not really, I've got ten minutes or so.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈɹɪli, aɪv ɡɑt tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ɔɹ soʊ/
dialogue.zh: 還好，大約有十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, please pull forward to the pickup window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊkeɪ, pliz pʊl ˈfɔːɹwɚd tə ðə ˈpɪkˌʌp ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，請往前開到取餐窗口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The little one around the corner?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɪtəl wʌn əˈɹaʊnd ðə ˈkɔːɹnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 轉角那個小窗口嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's it. I'll carry your bag right over.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɪt. aɪl ˈkæɹi jɔːɹ bæɡ ɹaɪt ˈoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 就是它。我馬上把餐袋送過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds good, I'll wait right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz ɡʊd, aɪl weɪt ɹaɪt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來不錯，我就在那裡等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Be with you in under two minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /bi wɪð ju ɪn ˈʌndɚ tuː ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘之內就過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No worries at all, take your time.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜːɹiz ət ɔːl, teɪk jɔːɹ taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 完全不急，您慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's your bag, plus a fresh large drink.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz jɔːɹ bæɡ, plʌs ə fɹɛʃ lɑːɹdʒ drɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 這是您的餐袋，還有全新的大杯飲料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks! And the coffee — did it survive?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks! ænd ðə ˈkɔːfi — dɪd ɪt sɚˈvaɪv/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！咖啡還好吧？沒灑出來吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safe in the holder, not a drop spilled.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf ɪn ðə ˈhoʊldɚ, nɑt ə dɹɑp spɪld/
dialogue.zh: 穩穩放在杯架裡，一滴都沒灑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good. Those paper cups get slippery.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊ ɡʊd. ðoʊz ˈpeɪpɚ kʌps ɡɛt ˈslɪpɚi/
dialogue.zh: 那就好。那些紙杯常常很滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, so we double-tape every lid now.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹuː, soʊ wi ˈdʌbəl ˈteɪp ˈɛvɹi lɪd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 是呀，所以我們現在每個杯蓋都加倍固定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Hey, can I grab some napkins?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs. heɪ, kaɪ ɡɹæb sʌm ˈnæpkɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 真好。對了，能給我一些紙巾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. Do you want salt and pepper too?
dialogue.phonetic: /əv ˈkɔːɹs. du ju wɑnt sɔlt ænd ˈpɛpɚ tuː/
dialogue.zh: 當然。鹽和胡椒也要嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and maybe two extra ketchup cups.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd ˈmeɪbi tuː ˈɛkstɹə ˈkɛtʃəp kʌps/
dialogue.zh: 好，再來兩份番茄醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three ketchups, coming right up.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹiː ˈkɛtʃəps, ˈkʌmɪŋ ɹaɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 三份番茄醬，馬上來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect timing, I already smell those fries.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜːɹfɪkt ˈtaɪmɪŋ, aɪ ɔːlˈɹɛdi smɛl ðoʊz ˈfɹaɪz/
dialogue.zh: 來得正好，我已經聞到薯條的香味了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! The fry basket's my third meal today.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ! ðə ˈfɹaɪ ˈbæskɪts maɪ θɜːɹd mil təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！那炸籃都變成我今天第三餐了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it always this crazy after eleven?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ˈɔːlweɪz ðɪs ˈkɹeɪzi ˈæftɚ ɪˈlɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 每天十一點之後都這麼忙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly weekends. Tonight is non-stop, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli ˈwikˌɛndz. təˈnaɪt ɪz ˈnɑn ˈstɑp, ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 大多是週末。今晚根本沒停過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, you handle it like a pro.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, ju ˈhændəl ɪt laɪk ə pɹoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你們處理得真專業。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aw, thanks, that makes the shift better.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ, θæŋks, ðæt meɪks ðə ʃɪft ˈbɛtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 啊，謝謝，這句話讓值班都變好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the way, do you have a rewards app?
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə weɪ, du ju hæv ə ɹɪˈwɔɹdz æp/
dialogue.zh: 對了，你們有積分應用程式嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! Scan the QR code on your receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs! skæn ðə ˌkjuː ˈɑɹd koʊd ɑn jɔːɹ ɹɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 有！掃描收據上的行動條碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice, I'll try it next week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊ naɪs, aɪl traɪ ɪt nɛkst wik/
dialogue.zh: 噢不錯，我下週試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New users get one free drink right away.
dialogue.phonetic: /nuː ˈjuzɚz ɡɛt wʌn ˈfɹi drɪŋk ɹaɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 新用戶馬上就送一杯飲料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, did you say free? Today's my day.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, dɪd ju seɪ ˈfɹi? təˈdeɪz maɪ deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 等等，你說免費？今天是我的幸運日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Enjoy the pie, and drive safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ! ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə paɪ, ænd dɹaɪv seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 哈！慢慢吃派，開車小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for fixing my drink so fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɔɹ ˈfɪksɪŋ maɪ drɪŋk soʊ fæst/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你這麼快幫我換飲料。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our mistake, so it's the least we can do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊɚ ˈmɪsteɪk, soʊ ɪts ðə list wi kæn duː/
dialogue.zh: 是我們弄錯的，這是最起碼的誠意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're great. I'll see you next weekend.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ɡɹeɪt. aɪl si ju nɛkst ˈwikˌɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 你真好。下個週末再見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll be here, probably just as busy.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil bi hɪɹ, ˈpɹɑbəbli dʒʌst æz ˈbɪzi/
dialogue.zh: 我們會還在這裡，大概一樣忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good luck with the rest of your rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd lʌk wɪð ðə ɹɛst əv jɔːɹ ɹʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 祝你們之後的尖峰時段順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks! Have a wonderful night, see you soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks! hæv ə ˈwʌndɚfəl naɪt, si ju sun/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！祝你有個美好夜晚，再見！

script.youtube_title: 【🚗深夜速食店】🥤「你說免費？」｜飲料換大杯・挪車取餐・手機付款｜聽完就能開口｜🌱A2初級｜💡不用背多聽就會用｜Drive-Thru Mix-Up
script.youtube_title_en: "Did You Say Free?" - Fixing a Wrong Drink Size at the Drive-Thru
script.youtube_description:
深夜路過速食店車道，端出來的飲料尺寸卻完全不對，該怎麼辦？這集60句沉浸式英文聽力，帶你看一次有禮又有效的窗口溝通。

劇情：常客點了四號套餐和大杯黑咖啡，手機付款後才發現飲料拿成小朋友的杯子。櫃檯人員立刻道歉，請他挪車到取餐窗，親自送上全新的大杯飲料，兩人還聊起會員積分、深夜尖峰與夜班日常。

你將學會：
- 用 Can I still order... 開始深夜點餐
- 用 That's a kids' cup 溫和指出訂單問題
- 請人挪車、補單、掃收據加入會員的實用句

每句都附國際音標與繁中翻譯，後半段還有逐句跟讀練習，聽完就能開口用。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
記得訂閱頻道、開啟小鈴鐺，每天一集沉浸式英文！
script.youtube_description_en:
Late-night drive-thru order, wrong drink size - what do you say? In this 60-line immersive English listening lesson, a regular customer politely points out the tiny cup, pulls forward to the pickup window, and leaves with a fresh large drink and a free-drink surprise.

You will learn to:
- Start a late-night order with Can I still order food?
- Say This drink cup is really tiny without sounding angry
- Understand pull forward, scan the QR code, and one free drink

Every line stays under ten words, with IPA and Traditional Chinese translations, plus a line-by-line repeat section.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new immersive listening quest every week!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🚗速食車道英文｜點錯飲料尺寸・挪車到取餐窗・掃收據送飲品｜聽完就能點餐｜🌱A2初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
忙到深夜，想靠一杯熱咖啡撐過開車回家的路，結果飲料拿錯尺寸，你會怎麼開口？
這一集帶大家走進深夜速食店車道，看一位常客如何禮貌地請櫃檯換掉小杯子，再把修正好的餐點順利取回。
你會聽到：
- 🥤 「This drink cup is really tiny.」— 用最簡單的詞指出問題。
- 🚗 「Please pull forward to the pickup window.」— 請你往前開的說法。
- 📱 「Scan the QR code on your receipt.」— 收據掃碼加入會員。
- 💡 「Wait, did you say free?」— 聽見「免費」時的真實反應。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧，每句十詞以內，慢速清楚，讓你聽了就想跟著唸。
🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。
祝你深夜用餐愉快，路上小心！
